title: Yang-Mills Existence and Mass Gap
exact_target: For every compact simple gauge group, construct a mathematically well-defined interacting Yang--Mills quantum field theory in four dimensions and prove that its first positive spectral energy is bounded away from zero.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1346 (GEOM-009). CC BY 4.0.
Arthur Jaffe and Edward Witten, \emph{Quantum Yang--Mills Theory}, official Clay Mathematics Institute Millennium Prize problem description, Sections 3--4, pp. 4--6.
